content.title: Where to get ESPN Unlimited free trial today with MLB.TV on Opening Day
content.text: Updated: Mar. 26, 2026, 9:00 a.m.Published: Mar. 26, 2026, 9:00 a.m.An ESPN logo is viewed on an equipment locker before an NFL football game between the Jacksonville Jaguars and the Kansas City Chiefs, Monday, Oct. 6, 2025, in Jacksonville, Fla. (AP Photo/Phelan M. Ebenhack)APIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By Joey Aliberti | JAliberti@syracuse.comThe 2026 MLB season began Wednesday, but Thursday is Opening Day for most MLB teams, with the remaining teams beginning their season Friday. There’s multiple ways to watch all the games, all while getting a free ESPN Unlimited subscription. How to get ESPN Unlimited for free with MLB.TVMLB.TV has now shifted over to ESPN, with a monthly subscription costing $29.99 a month and $149.99 for the season. Both the monthly and season-long subscriptions come with a free one-month ESPN Unlimited subscription. Just be aware that the ESPN Unlimited subscription will automatically renew after the first month for $29.99 each month after. MLB.TV subscribers can cancel their ESPN Unlimited account without losing their MLB.TV account. MLB.TV automatically comes with ESPN Unlimited, but you can immediately cancel the ESPN Unlimited account without any ramifications. ESPNGet one month of ESPN Unlimited free with a MLB.TV subscription. Buy NowWhat is ESPN Unlimited?ESPN Unlimited, formerly ESPN+, is a rebranded and repackaged over-the-top streaming service from ESPN that brings you even more of the live sports you love. The biggest upgrade from the old ESPN+ model? ESPN Unlimited includes all ESPN networks and services, including ESPN, ESPN2, ESPNU, ESPNEWS, ESPN Deportes, SEC Network, ACCN, and even streaming-exclusive networks and games ESPN+, ESPN on ABC, SECN+, ACCNX, ESPN3. It also includes direct feeds for live games that air on all of those networks, including ABC. On top of that, it also includes the new WWE Premium Live Events including Wrestlepalooza, Royal Rumble, Wrestlemania and more.ESPN channels are home to hundreds of college football and basketball games, Monday Night Football, UFC and the majority of NHL games, plus exclusive sports commentary, analysis and documentary programming, like “30 for 30.”What to know about MLB.TV MLB.TV serves a multitude of purposes. It allows baseball fans to watch every out-of-market game live or game replays (which typically release 90-120 minutes after the game). The subscription also comes with MLB Big Inning, which is baseball’s version of NFL RedZone. MLB Big Inning will take viewers to big moments as they’re happening in real time. Shows will air on a nightly basis, focusing on highlights around the league. For fans who aren’t in the area of their favorite team, MLB.TV is the best way to watch. Diehard baseball fans will also benefit from MLB.TV to complete access to all 30 teams throughout the season. MLB.TV doesn’t come with in-market broadcasts, meaning you won’t be able to watch the team geographically closest to you with the subscription. Other ways to get ESPN Unlimited for freeA subscription to MLB.TV is not the sole way to a free ESPN Unlimited account. Subscriptions to FuboTV (free trial) and DIRECTV (free trial) come with a complimentary ESPN Unlimited account. You can also add MLB.TV to those subscriptions, for the same price that it’s listed on ESPN.
